# Temporary v0.4 post-merge review blocker

This file exists only to open the protected follow-up PR for the two actionable findings discovered by the fresh Codex review after PR #54 merged. It must be removed before the follow-up PR is merged.

Required permanent fixes:

1. Reconcile a one-slot filesystem recovery-reserve deficit caused when a terminal SQLite transition rolls back after the nontransactional sidecar release. Reopen must restore the reserve to `reservation_rows + 1` before accepting the store, with a permanent rollback/retry regression that preserves genuine ENOSPC recoverability.
2. Validate the complete bounded `schema_migrations` ledger and fail closed on any unexpected migration entry, with a permanent regression for an injected unknown migration ID.

The Experimental no-executor/no-supported-external-mutation boundary must remain unchanged.
